answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on three datasets encompassing question answering (including knowledge base question answering-KBQA-and open-ended QA) and machine translation tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Text responses for question answering and translated text for machine translation

answer_2.quote: For WebQSP, we use precision, recall, and F1 scores. For MS MARCO, we employ BERTScore, using deberta-xlarge-mnli model to ensure optimal performance, as it provides the highest correlation with human evaluations. Results are reported as the average F1 score across the entire dataset, referred to as BERT-F1. For MAC, we employ the Crosslingual Optimized Metric for Evaluation of Translation (COMET), a neural-based evaluation metric that leverages contextual embeddings from pretrained language models to assess translation quality.

answer_3.quote: We also adopt Gemini-1.0-Pro to evaluate for the knowledge base question answering task (KBQA) where the ground-truth answers contains lists of entities instead of natural language text.
methods: KBQA evaluation using entity extraction and mapping
